summary: Part II Items 13-17 rows do not persist/render (either via form.fill or after adding 5 rows by hand through '+ Add row' and entering Tax Base), leaving Part II blank with 0.00 Tax Withheld; opening the 'Other Selected ATC rows' drawer puts the Done button offscreen at 1400px width. On Page 2 Schedule 1, Total Taxes Withheld and Remitted (55,650,177.41) and Tax Rate (6) print left-aligned, TINs print undashed (14 raw digits) and TIN/Name cells are shrunk to 5.7-7.0px by print-overrides/1600-vt-2018.css. Page 1 zero rows print 0.00, overremittance prints '-' in the comb, and Page 2 omits Table 1 ATC reference.

defects.where: Page 1, Part II Items 13-17 and 'Other Selected ATC rows' attachment drawer
defects.what: Part II rows 13-17 filled via form.fill or added by hand via '+ Add row' (entering Tax Base without an ATC picker selection) do not appear or print, leaving Items 13-18 at 0.00. Opening the 'Other Selected ATC rows' drawer places its Done button offscreen (x=1325) at 1400x900.

defects.where: Page 2, Schedule 1 Total Taxes Withheld and Remitted and Column (6) Tax Rate
defects.what: Schedule 1 Total Taxes Withheld and Remitted (55,650,177.41) prints left-aligned instead of right-aligned, and Column (6) Tax Rate ('5.00', '12.00') prints left-aligned flush against the left border with no '%' sign.

defects.where: Page 2, Schedule 1 Columns (2) TIN and (3) Name of Payees (#p2c16-i..#p2c45-i)
defects.what: Payee TINs print as 14 undashed digits ('00012345100000') instead of dashed format, and print-overrides/1600-vt-2018.css forces tiny 5.7-7.0px !important sizes on both TIN and Name of Payees.

defects.where: Page 1, Part II Items 13-19, 22-27 (zero rows and overremittance)
defects.what: Zero/unused Part II money combs print '0 | . | 00' instead of blank, and overremittance Items 22 and 27 print a leading '-' inside the comb instead of parentheses per the '(Overremittance)' caption.

defects.where: Page 2, bottom half (Table 1 - Alphanumeric Tax Code)
defects.what: Official Page 2 includes Table 1 (Alphanumeric Tax Code reference) below Schedule 1; printed Page 2 omits Table 1, leaving the bottom half blank.
